title: Manaaki Whenua Fundamental Soil Layer (FSL) — NZ Soil Classification
dateNote: Legacy mapping: source surveys vary from the 1960s to 2000. The WMS layer metadata lists publication in 2011. Not a current soil test.
scaleNote: Regional mapping at about 1:50,000. The 10 m app lookup grid is for display only and does not imply 10 m soil accuracy.
attribution: © Landcare Research NZ Limited 2009– · CC Attribution 3.0 NZ
license: Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 New Zealand (CC BY 3.0 NZ), as declared by this WMS/WFS service
coverageNote: All 14 source polygons intersecting the map extent have the same mapped group: Perch-Gley Pallic (PP). The overlay covers the entire map extent. This coarse classification does not describe every paddock or soil variation on site.
processing: WMS map image is unchanged in geographic content and re-encoded losslessly. Class lookup sampled from the complete-coverage image to 256×250 cells, north-to-south, using the verified PP palette. WFS feature attributes and six GetFeatureInfo queries independently verify the group. Source polygons are retained in optional GeoJSON; their original extents extend outside the farm context.
limitations: This is the legacy FSL classification, not S-map.
No pH, nutrient, rooting-depth or water-capacity values are provided by this particular service layer.
Group descriptions are general mapped soil characteristics, not a measurement or recommendation for an individual paddock.
